art_contracts.anti_regression: The 32px grid, legacy character sheets, ambient spritesheets, evidence glyphs, and building modules are never style references for primary environment or Places artwork.

base_image_frame.note: The runtime base is a full 6144x4608 overworld matching the saved 192x144 canonical world. Saved Case 004 location and evidence coordinates are already full-world coordinates and must be used directly. Subtracting a B2 offset is allowed only when deliberately converting documented legacy B2-local source metadata.

places_contract.evidence_policy: neutral pre-discovery base scenes; clue-bearing objects and marks are discovery-gated overlays or close views

legacy_rejected_assets.reason: Superseded RPG/tile-art views. Retained only for repository history and never valid as runtime, prompt, editor, or style references.

tile_contract.role: map placement geometry only, not an art style target

local_light_overlays.render_when: currentMinutes is within each overlay's from/to clock range
local_light_overlays.policy: Ambient occupancy and civic lighting only; no hidden culprit silhouettes or unearned clue state.

environmental_zones.note: loc_lake, loc_fishery, loc_woodland, and other exterior regions now sit over painted full-overworld terrain. Decorative terrain carries no evidence; evidence remains discovery-gated via visual.object_visuals.

notes: The transparent overlay carries no baked case state. Case 004 evidence changes such as the missing fountain coping, muddy bootprint, or moved objects are discovery-gated anchors, so baking them into an always-on overlay would leak undiscovered clues. Case-specific visual state therefore stays projection- and discovery-gated via visual.object_visuals; the overlay PNG is retained as a reserved layer slot but is not currently composited by the renderer.
